title: Лексическая точность и границы вывода
description: Выбираем точное слово по его функции в сложном тексте и сохраняем различия близких понятий.
objectives: Сохранять разницу между отсутствием доказательства и доказательством отсутствия
notes: В формальном контексте disinterested часто означает беспристрастный; uninterested — не проявляющий интереса. Контекст нужен, потому что употребление варьируется.
Failure to establish an effect не означает автоматически установление отсутствия эффекта.

exercises.prompt: Какую мысль автор защищает, различая два отрицательных вывода?

options.label: The report asks for reviewers who will not read the evidence.
An inconclusive result warrants neither a proven benefit nor a proven absence of benefit.
Every inconclusive result confirms that an intervention works.

public_payload.passage: An evaluation found no clear improvement after a small pilot. In the report, the result was described as inconclusive: the measures were too imprecise and the sample too limited to distinguish a modest benefit from no benefit. A summary then announced that the pilot had “proved the intervention ineffective”. That is a stronger claim. The original report had not established a benefit, but neither had it demonstrated the absence of one. This distinction is not an invitation to assume that the intervention works. It is a requirement to keep the conclusion within what the evidence can discriminate. The same report also called for disinterested reviewers, meaning reviewers without a stake in the outcome, not people who could not be bothered to examine it.

exercises.editorial_answer: An inconclusive result warrants neither a proven benefit nor a proven absence of benefit.
exercises.explanation: Неопределённый результат не доказывает ни пользу, ни её отсутствие; беспристрастность не равна равнодушию.

exercises.prompt: В формальном контексте выбери слово о рецензенте без личной выгоды от результата.

options.label: inadvertent
uninterested
disinterested

public_payload.sentence: The panel needs a ___ reviewer who has no financial stake in the outcome.

exercises.explanation: Здесь disinterested означает беспристрастный; uninterested означало бы отсутствие интереса.

exercises.prompt: Выбери ближайший синоним inadvertent при описании ошибки.

options.label: unrelated
unavoidable
unintentional

exercises.explanation: Inadvertent — непреднамеренный. Unavoidable означало бы неизбежный — это другое утверждение.

public_payload.source: Исследование не установило эффект; это не равнозначно доказательству его отсутствия.

accepted: The study did not establish an effect; this is not equivalent to proving its absence.
The study failed to establish an effect; that is not the same as proving that there was none.

exercises.reference_answer: The study did not establish an effect; this is not equivalent to proving its absence.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The study conclusively proved that there was no effect.
exercises.editorial_answer: The study did not establish an effect; this is not equivalent to proving its absence.
exercises.explanation: Нужно сохранить различие между failed to establish и proved absence; conclusively неоправданно усиливает вывод.

options.label: A disinterested reviewer need not be an uninterested reviewer.
An inconclusive result is always proof of complete ineffectiveness.
An inadvertent error need not be an unavoidable error.

exercises.editorial_answer: An inadvertent error need not be an unavoidable error.; A disinterested reviewer need not be an uninterested reviewer.
exercises.explanation: Непреднамеренность не означает неизбежность; беспристрастность не означает отсутствие интереса.

public_payload.sentence: The absence of clear findings do not establish that the intervention is ineffective.

accepted: The absence of clear findings does not establish that the intervention is ineffective.

exercises.reference_answer: The absence of clear findings does not establish that the intervention is ineffective.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The absence of clear findings proves that the intervention is ineffective.
exercises.editorial_answer: The absence of clear findings does not establish that the intervention is ineffective.
exercises.explanation: Подлежащее absence в единственном числе требует does not. Осторожный смысл нельзя заменять на proves.

options.label: No; an undetected benefit must therefore exist.
Not on that basis alone; we need to consider what effects the study could reliably detect.
Yes; any failure to detect something proves it impossible.

lines.speaker: Colleague
lines.text: The pilot did not establish a benefit. Can we say there is definitely none?

exercises.editorial_answer: Not on that basis alone; we need to consider what effects the study could reliably detect.
exercises.explanation: Нужно учитывать различающую способность исследования; ни отсутствие, ни наличие пользы автоматически не доказано.

exercises.prompt: Проверь подтекст, оговорки и точность C2.

questions.prompt: Что означает qualified praise в аналитическом тексте?

options.label: Praise without any reservation.
Praise limited by reservations.

questions.prompt: Что нужно сохранить при упрощении формального условия?

options.label: Only the shortest possible wording.
Its exceptions, conditions and modal force.

questions.prompt: Что позволяет заключить один лишь inconclusive result?

options.label: That one side has been conclusively proved.
That the available evidence does not settle the issue.

explanations.q2: Простота не оправдывает потерю условий, исключений и модальной силы.
explanations.q3: Inconclusive — не позволяющий решить вопрос на имеющихся данных.

exercises.editorial_answer: Praise limited by reservations.; Its exceptions, conditions and modal force.; That the available evidence does not settle the issue.
exercises.explanation: Контрольный блок засчитывается при всех верных ответах. Разбор каждого вопроса показан отдельно.
